question: Inside the large Stage35 unsafe patches, do teacher-free Arachne vertex deformation signatures expose the internal mechanical seams that Euclidean-only geodesic completion misses?
scores: Arachne skin-row half-L1 distance on an existing dense mesh edge
Jensen-Shannon divergence between Arachne skin rows
scope: All dense edges belonging to Stage35 unsafe connected components, reported separately for the two largest patches and globally.
teacher_policy: Teacher source-component identity is loaded only after all teacher-free scores are frozen and is used only to label evaluation pairs SAME_REGION or CROSS_REGION.

decision_rule.MOTION_EDGE_SIGNAL_STRONG: For at least one continuous teacher-free score, global ROC-AUC >= 0.90 and both largest patches ROC-AUC >= 0.85 when both classes exist.
decision_rule.MOTION_EDGE_SIGNAL_PARTIAL: Global ROC-AUC >= 0.75 but strong criterion is not met.
decision_rule.MOTION_EDGE_SIGNAL_WEAK: All continuous scores have global ROC-AUC < 0.75.
